# Analysis freeze v2.0 (post-annotation)

**Frozen:** 2026-10-02, from committed results at `d14d9ec` (`research/improvement`).
**Generated by:** `research/experiments/freeze_analysis_report.js`. Do not edit by hand: change an analysis, rerun it, then regenerate this file.
**Status:** the analysis after the two-annotator study, on benchmark v0.2.1. It supersedes v1.0, which stays unchanged as the pre-annotation record. Every number below comes from the result files listed in §12.
**Reading this report:** columns and rows labelled "v0.2" describe **benchmark v0.2.1** (the corrected v0.2), read from `research/results/v0.2.1`. v0.1 is unchanged. Every v1.0 observation restated here was recomputed from, or checked against, the v0.2.1 files.

**Conventions used throughout:**

- **Brackets** are 95% intervals: percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 42) unless marked Wilson or Clopper–Pearson.
- **Evaluation protocol:** 5-fold cross-validation stratified by label, seed 42. Every tuned quantity (α, thresholds, calibrators) is chosen on the 4 development folds and applied once to the test fold.
- **Status:** all analyses are exploratory, specified after results were seen.

| Population | v0.1 | v0.2 | Used for |

| All queries | 150 | 207 | appendix figures, bare-keyword and Split B checks (controls included) |

| — of which in-scope (non-OOD) | 110 | 132 | accuracy, false rejections |

- **Versions.** v0.2.1 contains 150 of the 150 v0.1 queries (TA-B145 and TA-B149 with corrected gold or acceptable commands), so the two are not independent samples.
- **Reproduction.** The published baseline reproduces exactly (0/150 mismatches). Mean latency 3.29 ms in the archived run (3.2129 ms in the reproduction run), on one machine; indicative only.

## 2. Confidence and calibration (non-control queries)

**Setup.**

- Isotonic recalibration is fit on development folds; controls are excluded from both fit and evaluation.
- The noise floor is the ECE of a perfectly calibrated forecaster with the same confidences and n (2,000 simulations, seed 7).
- Brier skill is measured against an out-of-fold forecaster that predicts the development base rate.

| Confidence | Ver. | n | ECE raw | ECE isotonic | Reduction | Equal-mass / sweep ECE (isotonic) | Noise floor mean / p95 | Brier skill raw | Brier skill isotonic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shipped | v0.1 | 125 | 0.323 | 0.069 | 79% [44%, 84%] | 0.110 / 0.059 | 0.064 / 0.105 | -0.227 [-0.453, 0.012] | 0.205 [0.040, 0.359] |
| Hybrid (fused top-1) | v0.1 | 125 | 0.329 | 0.108 | 67% [43%, 83%] | 0.108 / 0.055 | 0.054 / 0.089 | -0.321 [-0.500, -0.105] | 0.380 [0.204, 0.542] |
| Shipped | v0.2 | 182 | 0.286 | 0.119 | 58% [35%, 76%] | 0.094 / 0.049 | 0.054 / 0.085 | -0.029 [-0.233, 0.165] | 0.365 [0.215, 0.500] |
| Hybrid (fused top-1) | v0.2 | 182 | 0.384 | 0.064 | 83% [66%, 89%] | 0.071 / 0.044 | 0.049 / 0.077 | -0.369 [-0.578, -0.160] | 0.459 [0.320, 0.589] |

**Calibrator comparison** (shipped confidence, ECE / Brier; differences between calibrators not tested):

| Ver. | none | isotonic | Platt | histogram binning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v0.1 | 0.323 / 0.305 | 0.069 / 0.198 | 0.087 / 0.201 | 0.101 / 0.201 |
| v0.2 | 0.286 / 0.258 | 0.119 / 0.159 | 0.073 / 0.164 | 0.050 / 0.173 |

- Histogram binning is scored on the bins it fits, and has the worst Brier score of the three calibrators in every case (v0.1: 0.2011 against Platt 0.2005, equal at 3 decimals).
- Recalibration changes the confidence shown, not the answer.
- Shipped correctness AUROC falls from 0.742 to 0.686 (v0.1), because each fold has its own map.

**Method.** Risk-coverage curves use the exact expected risk under a random order within tied confidences, not benchmark row order. OOD answers count as errors.

| v0.1 | Shipped | 125 | 53 | 85 (68%) at conf 1, 22 errors | 25.9% (0.0%–34.9%) | 0.286 [0.200, 0.380] | 0.153 [0.110, 0.200] | 0.742 [0.662, 0.817] |
| v0.1 | Hybrid | 125 | 46 | 71 (57%) at conf 1, 8 errors | 11.3% (0.0%–12.7%) | 0.171 [0.105, 0.247] | 0.105 [0.069, 0.145] | 0.841 [0.765, 0.908] |
| v0.2 | Shipped | 182 | 87 | 102 (56%) at conf 1, 21 errors | 20.6% (11.0%–23.1%) | 0.270 [0.199, 0.348] | 0.157 [0.120, 0.196] | 0.831 [0.773, 0.884] |
| v0.2 | Hybrid | 182 | 84 | 85 (47%) at conf 1, 10 errors | 13.2% (13.2%–13.2%) | 0.213 [0.151, 0.283] | 0.136 [0.102, 0.173] | 0.881 [0.830, 0.926] |

**Paired differences, hybrid minus shipped** (paired bootstrap):

| Ver. | AURC | AUGRC | Correctness AUROC |
|---|---|---|---|
| v0.1 | -0.115 [-0.177, -0.054] | -0.048 [-0.073, -0.024] | 0.099 [0.008, 0.190] |
| v0.2 | -0.057 [-0.109, -0.005] | -0.021 [-0.042, 0.001] | 0.051 [-0.008, 0.111] |

AURC and AUGRC mix ranking with accuracy. Correctness AUROC isolates ranking. Intervals that include zero: v0.2.1 AUGRC, v0.2.1 correctness AUROC.

| v0.1 | hybrid vs BM25 | 0–7 | 6.36 [1.82, 10.91] | 0.0156 | 0.0078 | 0.0082 |

- **Ties with the tests.** Controls are never discordant, so the p values are identical with the controls included.
- **Bootstrap vs exact test.** The bootstrap intervals are not dual to the exact test.
- **Rounding.** Intervals are shown at the 2 decimals stored in `phase1_t1`.
- **Choice of test.** No comparison's side of 0.05 depends on the test used (exact, mid-p or asymptotic).

## 6. Out-of-scope rejection

**The three rules:**

- **Fixed:** the shipped rule, raw BM25 < 2.0.
- **Tuned threshold:** raw BM25 below an F1-maximizing threshold, chosen per fold on development folds.
- **Detector:** the hybrid fused top-1 score, thresholded the same way.

False rejections are counted over non-control in-scope queries; no rule ever rejects a control.

| Ver. | Rule | OOD rejected (Wilson) | False rejections | Thresholds per fold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v0.1 | Fixed rule | 4/15 (26.7%; 10.9%–51.9%) | 0/110 | 2.0 |
| v0.1 | Tuned shipped threshold | 10/15 (66.7%; 41.7%–84.8%) | 9/110 | 6.1905, 5.4242, 5.4242, 5.4242, 5.4242 |
| v0.1 | Hybrid detector | 7/15 (46.7%; 24.8%–69.9%) | 6/110 | 0.8327, 0.8327, 0.8327, 0.8946, 0.8946 (fused-score scale) |

## 8. Risky answers and the risk classifier (no safety claim)

**Setup.**

- Risk tiers come from a deterministic rule-based classifier applied to each returned command.
- The classifier misses at least one destructive command, so risky counts are lower bounds.
- Population: non-control queries, with OOD included.

| Ver. | System | Answered | High/critical returned | Of which wrong | Wrong at max confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| v0.1 | Shipped | 121 | 20 | 2 | 1 |
| v0.1 | Hybrid | 125 | 23 | 3 | 1 |
| v0.2 | Shipped | 165 | 21 | 2 | 1 |
| v0.2 | Hybrid | 182 | 26 | 6 | 1 |

**Wrong and risky answers.** No control is among them. Confidence is on each system's own scale: the shipped tool in %, the hybrid as a fused score in [0, 1].

- **The one genuine miss:** `git checkout -- .`, which discards uncommitted work.

- **Functional check:** 15 sandbox-safe queries; gold success 100%, hybrid success 93.3%. Exit code 0 counts as success.

## 10. Label reliability

- **κ.** A partially independent reviewer re-labelled 14 AI-authored v0.2 queries: Cohen's κ = 0.6316. The percentile bootstrap 95% interval is [0.391, 1.000] (9993/10000 valid resamples). This is below the pre-specified 0.7 target.
- **OOD labels.** The reviewer agreed on 8/8 (Clopper–Pearson [63%, 100%]). Of these, 7 were everyday requests and 1 a far-from-corpus task; none was a terminal task.
- **Disagreements.** All three were on ambiguous labels (3 of 6).

**Two-annotator study** (protocol fixed before any label existed: `research/datasets/annotation/ANNOTATION_PROTOCOL.md`). The reviewer check above is the earlier, smaller check; it is kept as history.

- **Primary κ** (unweighted Cohen's κ, 3 classes, 78 items): 0.980, 95% bootstrap interval [0.937, 1.000]; agreement 98.7%.
- **Targets only** (58): κ = 0.967 [0.897, 1.000]; agreement 98.3%.
- **Pre-declared criteria:** κ ≥ 0.7: MET; OOD confirmed ≥ 90%: MET. Both met.
- **Secondary:** κ OOD vs not 1.000 [1.000, 1.000]; AMBIGUOUS vs not 0.967 [0.885, 1.000].

## 11. Limitations the manuscript must carry

- Small, dependent, partly AI-authored benchmark (150 and 207 queries; 57 drafted by an AI agent). The earlier single-reviewer check was below target (κ = 0.6316). The two-annotator study (78 items) met both pre-declared criteria (κ = 0.980); with no third reader, 1 contested item was excluded and 4 reversed items were not relabelled.
- Apart from the two-annotator analysis, fixed before any label existed, all analyses were specified after the results were seen: the Holm family, the controls exclusion, the equal-false-rejection comparison and the sensitivity subsets. Accuracy tests rest on 7–15 discordant queries per comparison.
- Headline numbers use one fold partition (seed 42). Twenty partitions support the ranking and out-of-scope results, but "within the noise floor" is partition-dependent. Hybrid vs BM25 accuracy reaches p < 0.05 in 19/20 (v0.1) and 0/20 (v0.2.1) partitions.
- Only 10 of the 50 OOD queries are terminal tasks. Kind labels are AI-assigned. The added OOD queries were screened with raw retrieval scores, which favors the shipped score. The detector features were chosen on the full data, which may flatter the detector.
- Scope: one tool, one platform (Windows corpus of 279 commands), one small encoder (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), one fusion rule, exact-match scoring, and single-machine latency. No generative system, user study or public benchmark.
- The risk classifier is scored against the benchmark's own labels; one of its misses (TA-B194) reflects an inconsistent label. It misses at least one destructive command. The functional check covers 15 queries and treats exit code 0 as success.
- Ground-truth defects: in v0.1 (unchanged), TA-B145 has a gold command outside the corpus and TA-B149 has an acceptable command outside it, which lowers v0.1 non-OOD accuracy by 1 query for every system. v0.2.1 has none: it corrects TA-B145 and TA-B149 and drops TA-B187 and TA-B203 (`research/datasets/CHANGELOG_v0.2.1.md`).
